evidence: All survivors immediately identify textbook 2-SAT: deepseek-v4-flash writes '# 2-SAT: variable i -> 2*i for False, 2*i+1 for True', gpt-oss-120b builds standard implication graph 'A = lit_to_node(a); NA = A ^ 1', and glm-5 notes '# Build implication graph ... Negation: x ^ 1'.
affordance_in_statement: The inspectors have determined that a critical failure will occur if and only if the finalized schedule rejects both of the conditions highlighted in a given assessment. ... Each of the following m lines provides two non-zero integers l1 and l2 (1 <= |li| <= n), representing the two conditions highlighted by a vulnerability assessment. A positive integer k means the condition requires hub k to be ACTIVE. A negative integer -k means the condition requires hub k to be DORMANT.
removal_suggestion: The literal pair input format and the requirement to satisfy at least one condition per pair define pure 2-SAT. Because input format and the logical relations between hubs are immutable core requirements, the 2-SAT structure cannot be eliminated without altering the underlying problem.
